mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the adjusted rover was most worthwhile: the straight line and loop made differential steering easy to picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Powering the remote was necessary but predictable, with little to learn from that step alone.

surprise.text: The initial straight-ahead command drew a curve because one motor was faster; adjusting the control corrected the cause.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though several were straightforward preparations rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: the steering test and final drawing made the mechanism understandable and gave it a playful purpose, although many steps were predictable.
